hypotheses.justification: Partition gives V ⊆ U and W ⊆ U, hence ZFSet.sUnion {V,W} ⊆ U. Applying regular_mono and rewriting with hU.2 proves supCode c {V,W} ⊆ U without hF or supCode_le_iff. The remaining proof is unchanged and uses neither hV nor hW. This argument handles empty sets as well; both hypotheses can be deleted together.

Replace hF and hle by regular_mono applied to ZFSet.sUnion {V,W} ⊆ U, obtained from h.1 and h.2.1, then rewrite regular c U = U using hU.2. The remaining proof uses neither hW nor hV, with no exceptional empty-set cases. Both hypotheses can be deleted together.
